## D-DDV2 — DiffusionDriveV2: the released code vs the paper, results, and transfer to REF-C (2026-09-05, Research Lab / Arch+Inference)



Evidence for every row: `TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-05-diffusiondrive-v2-analysis/RESULT.md` (+ `raw/2512.07745v1_text.txt`, `raw/ddv2_src/` Apache-2.0 copies of every upstream file read with sha256s in `raw/ddv2_fetched_sha256.txt`, `raw/ddv2_noise_magnitudes.{py,json}`). Sources: arXiv 2512.07745v1 (lib `2512.07745`) read 17/17 pp; `hustvl/DiffusionDriveV2@1cd12a1` with `diffusiondrivev2_model_rl.py` and `diffusiondrivev2_model_sel.py` read IN FULL; v1 counterparts at `hustvl/DiffusionDrive@9b52ed0`. Builds on `D-REFC-DDAUDIT-1..6` / `H-DDA-1..4` (above, commit `7c67b3d`) and on `D-RL-REFCV3` / `H-RL-REACH-1` / `H-RL-THRESH-1` — cites them, does not restate them. Zero GPU; our code was NOT re-audited.



| id | claim / hypothesis | status | evidence |

|---|---|---|---|

| D-DDV2-CODE-1 | ⭐⭐ **THE REWARD THE PAPER NEVER DEFINES IS NAVSIM's PDM SIMULATOR SCORE, AND THE `collision` PREDICATE OF Eq. 10 IS `NC ≠ 1 OR DAC ≠ 1`.** `TrajectoryHead.__init__` instantiates `PDMSimulator` + `PDMScorer` from `default_scoring_parameters.yaml` (`_model_rl.py:741-753`; 4 s @ 10 Hz LQR-tracked rollout, replayed agents) in a 16-process pool; `_pairwise_scores` (`:75-117`) rebuilds `NC × DAC × (5·EP + 5·TTC + 2·C)/12` per candidate with **EP re-normalised against the GT's own progress**; the −1 branch fires on `no_collision != 1` **or `drivable_area != 1`** (`:900-902`), the paper says collision only. Upgrades the 2026-08-29 RL-library research's "HYPOTHESIS, NOT ASSERTED — the reward is PDMS" to PUBLISHED-CODE; the paper still does not say it | **SUPPORTED (PUBLISHED-CODE @ `1cd12a1`)** | RESULT.md §1.2 (d), (f) |

| D-DDV2-CODE-2 | ⭐⭐ **THE RELEASED EXPLORATION IS TWO SCALARS PER ANCHOR (ALONG-TRACK SCALE, LATERAL SCALE) — THE ADDITIVE "η = 1 DDPM" NOISE IS MULTIPLIED BY ZERO, AND BOTH σ FLOORS BIND EVERYWHERE.** `std_dev_t_add = 0.0` in both branches (`:640,:643`); `prev_sample = prev_sample_mean · (1 + 0.04·ε_{long,lat})` (`:646-666`). ESTIMATED from the diffusers `scaled_linear` schedule (`raw/ddv2_noise_magnitudes.json`): σ_t(η=1) = 0.0083–0.0120 at every rollout step t ∈ {18,…,2}, below both floors (0.04 exploration, 0.10 likelihood) ⇒ exploration std is a constant **4 % of the coordinate** (0.40 m at x = 10 m, 1.60 m at 40 m; 0.08 m at y = 2 m) and the likelihood std a constant **5.0 m (x) / 2.0 m (y)**; the noise schedule plays no role in the RL stage | **SUPPORTED (PUBLISHED-CODE + ESTIMATED)** | RESULT.md §1.2 (b), §1.3 #2–3 |

| D-DDV2-CODE-3 | ⭐ **THE ESTIMATOR IS PLAIN REINFORCE WITH A MISMATCHED LIKELIHOOD, A GT-ANCHORED BAR AND A GLOBAL IL PULL — NOT GRPO AND NOT A TRUST REGION.** `per_token_loss = −exp(logp − logp.detach())·A` (`:1096`, ratio ≡ 1, one update per rollout; no clip, no KL, no reference policy — confirming the sibling's derivation); the log-likelihood is an isotropic Gaussian over 16 coordinates with σ = 0.1 evaluated on samples from the 2-scalar multiplicative law (`:668-675`) — **not the sampler's density**, so `refcv3_adapter.py`'s "surrogate Gaussian, stated limit" is the same class of object as the published estimator; positive advantage ONLY where `reward > reward_GT − 1e-6` (`:892-893`, absent from Eq. 10); intra-anchor `(r − mean_G)/(std_G + 1e-4)` with G = 4 (`:886-889`, `_rl_config.py:37`), discount `0.8^(T−i−1)` over T = 10 rollout steps (`:801,:926-932`); IL = L1 of **all 80 chains** to the GT at every step/layer, λ = 0.1 or **1.0 when no sample beat the human** (`:1104-1118`); v1's `poses_cls` is computed, untrained and unread; **trunk + agent/BEV heads frozen and in eval mode, only `_trajectory_head` trains** (`_rl_agent.py:61-67`) | **SUPPORTED (PUBLISHED-CODE)** | RESULT.md §1.2 (a), (c), (d), (e), (j); §1.3 #3–7 |

(2) The high-value build is a **FEASIBILITY-AWARE OFFSET** — a reparameterisation or penalty keeping the ROLLED path inside the envelope, applied where the offset is produced rather than after it. | D-FEASDEC-SPECERR-1 | ⚠️ **A CLAIM IN THIS PACKAGE'S OWN SPEC WAS WRONG, AND ITS OWN DELIBERATE NO-OP CONTROL CAUGHT IT.** SPEC §1 claimed that ANY per-window monotone renormalisation of `along` moves the per-window Spearman by exactly zero, and therefore that every "re-normalise progress" proposal is a provable no-op. MEASURED: **true of the UNCLAMPED ratio (0.00e+00, exact) and FALSE of the clamped component (0.0234)** — the `[-1, 1.5]` clamp is NOT monotone: it creates TIES, and a Spearman moves when ties move. ⭐ The cap's tie-making is itself the measured half of the P1 lever: `progress_v2` with the CAP ONLY reads ρ(`peak_g`) **+0.1294** from +0.2900, i.e. the cap alone more than halves the correlation purely by creating ties. ⇒ **a structural claim about a metric must name the exact object it is true of** — ratio vs clamped component — and the control that confirms a predicted no-op is worth running precisely because it can refute the prediction | **CORRECTED IN THE SAME TURN (MEASURED 2026-09-05)** | `…/2026-09-05-feasible-decode/RESULT.md` §4.1, `raw/progress_rank_fix_240w.json` (`no_op_claim` block) |

(i) **waypoint-indexed spatial** — recovered in PV today (`H-DDA-1`, 0 new bytes) and later on a camera-lifted BEV; (ii) **agent cross-attention** — recovered from a monocular 3D detector trained on `obstacle.offline` **labels** (97.44 % coverage, 0 new bytes), which is admissible under the binding rule *labels may use privileged signals; inference is vision-only* (PI 2026-08-03); (iii) **ego-query — deliberately refused**, because the FiLM + `ego_dropout 0.5` + X15 design is the one lever MEASURED to make an arm read the scene (`H-ECHO-8`) and DD's ego query is an unguarded echo channel. ⇒ **the audit's structural gap is a VISION-ONLY gap, not a LiDAR gap** | **DECIDED** | RESULT.md §2.7, §3.9 |

| D-V5A-OCC-LIMIT | ⛔ **"OCCUPANCY" IN v5a MEANS AGENT OCCUPANCY PLUS AN EXPLICIT UNOBSERVED MASK — GENERAL/STATIC OCCUPANCY IS NOT SUPPORTED BY THIS CORPUS AT ALL.** SurroundOcc/TPVFormer/Occ3D-style occupancy needs static structure; our only 3D label source is `obstacle.offline`, **10 classes, all dynamic** (re-MEASURED today over 87,481 cuboids), and PhysicalAI-AV ships no map, lane graph, junction annotation or traffic-light feature, with no lat/lon in `egomotion`. Two consequences: (a) `bev_raster.py`'s existing agent raster ([120, 64] over 60 m × ±16 m @ 0.5 m, with `fov_mask` / `fov_census`) **is** the v5a occupancy target and should be reused, not rebuilt; (b) ⛔ **a one-camera BEV lift covers a 33.4 % frustum and every out-of-frustum cell is UNOBSERVED, not free** — an unmasked BEV is the zero-memmap trap in a new costume, so **every v5a BEV carries a `fov_mask` and every loss is masked by it**. ⚠️ Published LSS/BEVDet/BEVFormer/BEVDepth/SimpleBEV numbers are **6-camera surround** numbers and are **inadmissible** for a one-camera arm | **DECIDED** | RESULT.md §2.3, §2.6 |

| D-V5A-CYLINDRICAL | ⚠️ **EVERY PUBLISHED CAMERA→BEV LIFT ASSUMES A PINHOLE UNPROJECTION AND IS SILENTLY WRONG ON OUR FRAME.** Our canonical frame is **256 × 640 CYLINDRICAL**, `f_ref` 305.577, HFOV **120.0°**; the correct unprojection is explicit (`φ = (u − W/2)/f_ref`, ray `(cos φ, sin φ, ·)`, tan-based vertical), not `K⁻¹[u,v,1]` — the pinhole formula reads **92.6°** for a 120° camera (CLAUDE.md FOV trap). ⭐ And cylindrical is *easier*: the column is **linear in azimuth**, so each feature column is one constant-width BEV ray fan ⇒ **a polar-native BEV is the recommended v5a form**, with `bev_raster.readout_column_index(projection="cylindrical")` already implementing the forward map. Resolution ledger: native 1080p wide **0.0625°/px**, native tele **0.0156°/px**, our canonical frame **0.1875°/px**, the trunk's 8 × 20 PV map **6.0°/column** (≈ 3.1 m lateral at 30 m — wider than a lane) | **DECIDED (MEASURED / derived)** | RESULT.md §1.2, §2.1, §2.3 |

| D-V5A-LADDER | **THE v5a LADDER: ten one-lever pre-registered work packages, ≈ 13.4 rig-GPU-hours serial, of which FOUR start at zero pod GPU and zero new bytes** — WP-V5A-0 (`E-THOR-MV`), WP-V5A-1 (`E-AGT-0`), WP-V5A-4 (`E-DDA-1` = `H-DDA-1`), WP-V5A-6 (`E-DEPTH-0`). Then WP-V5A-2/-3 (the agent-accuracy budget and the detector), -5 (which feature stage is sampled), -7/-9 (the surround pilot then the corpus), -8 (the masked polar lift), and **WP-V5A-F**, the full-scale refcv5a run, which ⛔ **waits for refcv4b's final eval to free the A40** and bundles **only** levers that passed their own rung. ⛔ **No arm in this document has been launched** | **DECIDED — no arm launched** | RESULT.md §3 |

| D-V5A-BOUNDARY | ⭐⭐ **THE v5a/v5b DECISION RULE: v5a PRODUCES THE NUMBER THAT PRICES v5b.** Every v5b argument reduces to *"how much range accuracy are we missing?"*, and two v5a rungs measure exactly that at **zero new bytes** — `E-DEPTH-0` (range error vs distance against the `obstacle.offline` box centres) and `E-AGT-1` (the σ at which our own separation dies). ⇒ **v5b is scheduled iff `E-AGT-1`'s σ bar lands below what `E-DEPTH-0`/`E-AGT-2` achieve**; if it lands above, LiDAR is a **safety** investment (the unclassed-object case), to be argued on its own terms, not a performance one. Two honesty items that belong to the PI's decision: ⛔ **even WITH LiDAR we cannot compute a NAVSIM-style DAC** (no map, no lane graph, no lat/lon), and ⛔ **occlusion is closed by neither release** — LiDAR does not see through a van, and crediting it with occlusion reasoning is where the LiDAR gain is routinely over-estimated. v5b's real, irreducible adds: metric range without a learned prior · the **unclassed object** · **night** (MEASURED **15.41 %** of the corpus, 14.4 % of our r0 selection) · static volume (not semantics) | **DECIDED (decision rule) — needs PI sign-off; interacts with the unresolved `D-REFCV5-PLAN-7` LiDAR-at-inference doctrine call** | RESULT.md §4 |

| H-V5A-THOR | **A second and third camera batched through the ONE vision trunk cost sub-linearly on Thor: p50 trunk latency at 3 views ≤ 1.30× the 1-view p50** (Thor's 20 SMs saturate well above batch 1). **WP-V5A-0**, ≈ 20 min, inference only, no training GPU. Control that must read a known value: the 1-view **end-to-end** tick must reproduce **60.3 ms p50 / 63.1 ms p95**, else the rig is wrong and the sweep is inadmissible; deliberate regression: 6 views must be visibly slower than 3 (a flat 1–6 curve means the timer is not measuring the trunk). ⛔ Only in-process `torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()` is admissible for memory on Thor; never quote an A40 latency. Outcomes: **≤ 1.30× ⇒ surround cameras are an affordable INFERENCE INPUT**; **≥ 2.0× ⇒ surround is a TRAINING-TIME TEACHER only and WP-V5A-7 inverts into a distillation arm** | **OPEN — pre-registered, both outcomes committed** | RESULT.md §3.1 |

| H-V5A-AGT-1 | ⭐ **THE ORACLE-TOKEN CEILING. A `cross_agent` attention fed K = 30 GROUND-TRUTH `obstacle.offline` boxes at inference beats the no-token control on the LONGITUDINAL family (headway / time-gap / TTC vs the replay) AND on TACTICAL**, paired episode-cluster bootstrap over the 141 eval clips, CI excluding 0. **WP-V5A-1**, 4 arms ≈ 2.0 h on the rig, **+≈ 1.2 M params, zero-init gated (bit-identical at step 0)**. ⛔ The oracle arm is **deliberately inadmissible as a capability claim** (it feeds a label at inference, violating I3) and is run **once**, purely as a ceiling, behind an `AGENT_ORACLE=1` flag a deployable config can never set (asserted OFF by a test). Controls: **constant token set** must read the no-information value; **no-token** = today's arm; **deliberate regression = temporally shuffled boxes**, which must LOSE. Outcomes: **separation ⇒ the ceiling IS the budget, proceed to `H-V5A-AGT-2`**; **no separation ⇒ NO detector accuracy can help and the entire agent-token mechanism is REFUSED for zero further GPU-days** | **OPEN — pre-registered, both outcomes committed** | RESULT.md §2.5, §3.2 |

| H-V5A-AGT-2 | **THE DETECTOR ACCURACY BAR IS A DERIVED QUANTITY, NOT A LITERATURE NUMBER: degrading the oracle boxes with calibrated range noise (σ ∈ {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4} m) and, as a separate one-variable panel, a miss-rate sweep {0, 10, 25, 50 %}, locates the σ at which `H-V5A-AGT-1`'s separation dies.** **WP-V5A-2**, 6 arms ≈ 2.9 h, zero new bytes; σ = 0 must reproduce `H-V5A-AGT-1` exactly. Outcomes: **survives to σ ≥ 1 m ⇒ a monocular detector in the published band suffices, build WP-V5A-3**; **dies below σ = 0.5 m ⇒ the mechanism needs LiDAR-grade range and is a v5b item — a clean, quantitative v5a/v5b boundary** | **OPEN — pre-registered, both outcomes committed** | RESULT.md §3.3 |

| H-V5A-AGT-3 | **A DETR-style monocular 3D head (K = 30 queries, Hungarian, `obstacle.offline`'s 10 dynamic classes) trained as an auxiliary head on the shared trunk produces tokens inside the `H-V5A-AGT-2` σ budget, and its tokens recover a stated fraction of the oracle margin.** **WP-V5A-3**, 3 arms ≈ 3.0 h, **+2–4 M params**, vision-only at inference. Deliberate regression: the head trained on **shuffled** labels — its tokens must not help. A shortfall against the budget is reported **as the v5b case**, ⛔ never as a failure to be re-tuned | **OPEN — pre-registered** | RESULT.md §3.4 |

| H-V5A-DEPTH-1 | **A self-supervised monocular depth head reaches a metric range accuracy, at typical lead distances, sufficient for the LONGITUDINAL family — and its TWO independent scale anchors agree.** Anchor A: **known camera height 1.43–1.56 m** (`D-V5A-GROUND1`). Anchor B: **measured ego speed** (PackNet-SfM velocity supervision — exact here, because `v0` at cycle time is a measured, PI-sanctioned input). **The agreement of A and B is the control**: a disagreement beyond a few percent means the depth is wrong and says so. **WP-V5A-6**, 2 arms ≈ 1.0 h, zero new bytes. Readout is **range error vs distance at the `obstacle.offline` box centres**, plus a mandatory **raw-input floor** (predict the corpus-median range for that image row) the head must beat. ⛔ v5a uses depth as a **supervision signal for the lift**, never as "pseudo-LiDAR" points — an inferred cloud is a learned prior rendered as geometry and inherits every failure of the depth net while *looking* like a sensor | **OPEN — pre-registered** | RESULT.md §2.4, §3.6 |

| H-V5A-CAM-1 | **The cross pair as trunk input (shared trunk + view embedding) separates on the LATERAL and TACTICAL families against the front-only control**, on a **100-clip pilot (≈ 3 GB)** fetched by **HTTP range reads of zip members**, not whole chunks. **WP-V5A-7**, 2 arms ≈ 1.0 h. ⚠️ n = 100 is small: the failure branch reports **UNDERPOWERED with its n**, never "no effect". ⭐ Whichever way it goes, this rung **validates the range-read fetcher on 3 GB of camera** — a mechanism that is still a HYPOTHESIS on **v5b's** critical path (`REFCV5_DESIGN_PLAN.md` §3.1) and strictly cheaper to prove here than to discover failing on 1.57 TB of LiDAR. If `H-V5A-THOR` returns the linear answer, this arm **inverts into a distillation arm** (the cross pair supervises a 360° agent-presence target the front-only trunk must predict; tick unchanged) — **both variants are pre-registered and `H-V5A-THOR` selects which runs** | **OPEN — pre-registered, both variants committed** | RESULT.md §2.2, §3.7 |

| H-V5A-BEV-1 | **An LSS-style POLAR-native camera→BEV lift from the stride-8 stage, indexed directly by the fan (both are rig-frame), improves the LONGITUDINAL and TACTICAL families over `H-DDA-1`'s PV grounding.** **WP-V5A-8**, 3 arms ≈ 1.5 h; ⛔ **gated on `H-DDA-1` separating first** — if grounding in PV does not separate, geometry is not what is missing and a lift is premature. First arm's target is **the agent raster alone** (zero new data), so it measures whether a *metric frame* helps before anything is spent on *depth*. ⛔ **Deliberate regression: the same lift with `fov_mask` removed** (out-of-frustum = free) — it must be CAUGHT; if masked and unmasked arms are indistinguishable, the occupancy readout is not measuring occupancy | **OPEN — pre-registered** | RESULT.md §2.3, §3.8 |

| H-V5A-LEAD | **v5b's marginal value concentrates on FAR, LATERAL, OCCLUDED and NIGHT agents, not on the headway signal we most need** — because the LONGITUDINAL family is dominated by the **lead vehicle**, which is close, large and centred (the regime where monocular range is most accurate), while **92.2 % of our measured deficit is along-track** (`D-REFCV3-AXIS1`). ⇒ a maximised v5a captures most of the lead-vehicle benefit. **Refuted or supported by `H-V5A-DEPTH-1`'s range-error-vs-distance curve for the price of two tiny arms**, and by a **night-stratified** four-family table on any v5a arm (free: night is 15.41 % of the corpus) | **OPEN — pre-registered, 0 GPU beyond the rungs already listed** | RESULT.md §4.2 |

| D-REFCV5-PLAN-3 | ⭐ **PhysicalAI-AV CARRIES LiDAR — the PI was right.** `lidar/lidar_top_360fov`, 128-row spinning (`lidar_intrinsics.offline`: `row-offset-spinning`, 128 × 3600), 10 Hz, ~200 spins per 20 s clip, Draco-compressed, on **298,326 of 306,152 clips = 97.44 %**, 3,146 chunks × 31.7 GB = **99.6 TB, 68 % of the dataset by bytes**; extrinsics in `sensor_extrinsics.offline` (8 sensors = 7 cameras + LiDAR), the same rig frame `obstacle.offline` uses ⇒ **a LiDAR BEV is directly indexable by the anchor fan, with no camera projection involved**. The artifact is a DD-faithful **256 × 256 @ 0.25 m/px, ±32 m, 2-height-bin histogram** as a **PNG sidecar `<clip>.v2bev.pt`** beside the existing `*.v2ep.pt` — priced against the CONSUMER's loader (`v2_dataset.py::V2CompressedCache._payload`), ≈ **3–8 MB/episode** against 34.0 MB of camera, so the 161 GB cache is not rewritten and frames stay byte-identical (I6) | **SUPPORTED (MEASURED — three independent probes: HF blob listing 2026-09-05; the DataFlyWheel's 36-feature probe; the dataset card)** ⇒ work package **WP-DE-BEV-1**, owner DataFlyWheel, consumer Arch+Inference | §3.1–§3.3; `…/Data Engineering/Implementation/incoming/2026-07-26-physicalai-feature-probe/PHYSICALAI_FEATURE_PROBE.md` §1; ⚠️ adding it is a **declared change** to `stack/tests/test_physicalai_feature_readset.py`, a new named layer, never a silent edit |

| D-REFCV5-PLAN-4 | ⭐ **THE DIFFUSION NOISE LIVES IN CONTROL SPACE, NOT METRE SPACE.** `ε` on `(a_lon, a_lat)` normalised by the grid's own ranges `(4.0, 3.0)` and re-rolled through `rollout_unicycle_varstep`, so every sample is **flyable by construction** and the vocabulary stays the prior. Arithmetic: at t = 8 the `scaled_linear` schedule gives √(1−ᾱ₈) = 0.0316 ⇒ DD's metre normalisation is σ 0.90 m along / 0.73 m lateral **per waypoint independently** = ≈ 5.8 m/s² (0.6 g) implied lateral acceleration over a 0.5 s slot; in control units the same schedule is **0.126 / 0.095 m/s²**, i.e. ≈ 2.3 m along and ≈ 1.7 m lateral at the 6 s endpoint — comparable coverage, every sample integrable. The 8-slot control sequence has the **same 16 degrees of freedom** as the waypoint offset it replaces, so nothing expressible becomes inexpressible | **DECIDED — both outcomes committed.** Deliberate-regression arm = the DD-literal metre-space (`norm_odo`) sampler, which **must FAIL the flyability gate or the panel is VOID**; control = `σ ≡ 0, t = 0` must reproduce the deterministic decoder **bit-for-bit** | §4.2, §4.3 (file-level plan, 0 GPU to implement); `kinematic.py::rollout_unicycle_varstep/unicycle_controls_from_path_varstep/control_smoothness_losses`; `H-DDA-3` |

family `CLAUDE.md` already catalogues under `df` / Thor `free` / `step_s` / anchor-units: **a value is

inadmissible without the scope it is true in.** A WEIGHT without the term it weights (P1), a run

RECORD without the knob it trained at (P2), a query BUDGET without the corpus its density was

measured on (P3), a DIGEST without the artifact it covers (P4). In every one the failure wore the

costume of a working configuration.

| ⭐⭐⭐ **H-RL-OBJECTIVE-1** | **THE RL ARM'S OBJECTIVE IS THE *SELECTOR*, NOT THE GENERATOR'S SAFETY — AND THE PROJECTION IS WHAT MAKES THAT ARM SAFE TO RUN.** A projection can only DELETE or RETRACT members of a candidate set: it cannot add a member the vocabulary never contained, and it cannot change which member is chosen. That partitions the remaining defects, each with today's number: **(a) emitting something unsafe — SOLVED structurally** (contact 3.428 % → 0.000000 %, envelope 0.8877 → 0.0000); **(b) ⭐ CHOOSING badly inside a safe set — a projection provably CANNOT touch it**, and it is **oracle-in-fan 0.2306 m vs selected 0.4871 m = a 2.11× selection gap, EXACTLY unchanged by the projection (Δ 0.0000, CI [0,0])**, still **2.10×** inside the selector's own top-32 (0.2320 vs 0.4871); **(c) not CONTAINING the right answer** — refav1's `κ ∈ {0, 0.08}` vs a corpus median `|κ|` of 0.00085, **38.7 %** of turns expressible — **a representability fix, not RL**; **(d) the AGENT's behaviour** — the unavoidable class, a perception/prediction problem; **(e) agent-track COVERAGE** — the projection is inert on **175 / 240** windows with no track and reports `NO_AGENT`, never "safe". ⭐⭐ **The strongest consequence is not that RL is unnecessary. The measured reason the veto arm failed is that it PAID ADE FOR SAFETY (+0.0362 m separated worse; `LON_accel_mae` +0.3349 on a base of 0.6806). On a PROJECTED fan that trade is unavailable — every candidate is already collision-free and friction-feasible — so a reward that is purely selection quality CANNOT buy safety with ADE, because there is no unsafe candidate left to move mass away from.** ⇒ the brief changes from *"make the fan safer"* to *"close the 0.2565 m / 2.11× gap between the fan's best member and the one the model picks"*, on a candidate set where the safety axis is a constant | **HYPOTHESIS — proposed arm; the residual it inherits is MEASURED (0.2565 m per window, 240 windows / 121 episodes), the arm itself is NOT YET RUN** ⚠️ needs a **replicate arm** (`H-ESTIM-SEED-1`) once a training lever is involved | `RESULT.md` §8 |



⚠️ **`H-ESTIM-SEED-1` DOES NOT APPLY TO THE INTERVALS IN THIS SECTION, and the reason is worth

stating because the rule is otherwise binding.** Every arm here is a **deterministic transform of

ONE fixed tensor from ONE checkpoint** — there is no second training run anywhere in the

comparison, and the only randomness is the episode draw, which is exactly what the

episode-cluster bootstrap models. No replicate arm is required and none would mean anything.

### D-REFAV1-TURNASYM — the CLUSTER CEILING and the GOAL-HEAD BASELINE (2026-09-06 00:55, registered WHILE the arms ran and BEFORE any `cl` output existed)

| id | claim | class | evidence / consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D-REFAV1-TURNASYM-GOALHEAD** | ⭐⭐ **THE GOAL HEAD IS ITSELF ASYMMETRIC, AND IT SITS UPSTREAM OF THE CURVATURE PENALTY.** On the 75-window wide panel the decoded goal (an INPUT: `lat_head(intent)` from vision + nav + `v0`, identical across all seven banked arms **including across plan seeds**) reads **goal recall LEFT 0.3000 [0.0000, 0.6333]** against **RIGHT 0.6667 [0.3125, 0.9375]**, pooled contrast **+0.3667 [−0.3433, +0.8525] — NOT separated**; the **wrong-DIRECTION rate** is **9/30 = 0.3000** on GT-left against **2/30 = 0.0667** on GT-right, a **4.50x** difference. | MEASURED, zero GPU, CPU-only (`raw/goaldecode_probe.py` / `.txt` / `_rows.json`) | ⛔ **Because at `W_KAPPA = 0` the plan IS the goal's canonical seed on 21/22 turn-goal windows (`D-REFAV1-TURNASYM-SEED-WINS`), the plan's turn recall is BOUNDED ABOVE by the head's.** ⇒ a plan-recall gap is **partly INHERITED**, and *"the penalty costs LEFT turns first"* cannot be read off the plan's gap alone. **Registered before any result: the plan's recall is reported BESIDE the head's on the same windows, and only the INCREMENT over the head is attributed to the cost.** |
| **D-REFAV1-TURNASYM-CLUSTER-CEILING** | ⛔⛔ **ON THIS EVAL SLICE, LEFT/RIGHT TURN BEHAVIOUR VARIES MORE BETWEEN EPISODES THAN BETWEEN DIRECTIONS — and that, not n, is what bounds every per-direction claim.** Within-episode goal-head contrast: ep 0 **+0.8333**, ep 2 **+1.0000**, ep 6 ⛔ **−1.0000**, ep 7 **+1.0000**; mean **+0.4583 [−0.5000, +1.0000], not separated**. Three episodes say right, one says left, and a bootstrap over four clusters cannot choose. | MEASURED | ⇒ **Settling the asymmetry needs MORE EPISODES, not more windows.** Raising n per direction from 11/8 to **30/30** did **not** raise the number of CLUSTERS, which is what the decision estimator actually consumes. ⭐ **That is a CORPUS request, not a compute request** — and it is the honest unblock. ⚠️ It does NOT license reading a null as a result: if the panel returns outcome C the report is *"the eval slice cannot resolve an effect of this size"*, never *"there is no asymmetry"*. |

| id | claim | status | evidence |

Resolution hypothesis: **NOT SUPPORTED, NOT REFUTED**, now for a second independent reason (the first was power: ~6 positives scored at base rate 0.058) | **AMENDS `RESULT_WPH_TRUNK_VS_PIXELS.md`** | as above |

Both arms saw the same frame and the same labels, so the mismatch is **common-mode** for that comparison. *"Raw pixels beat the trunk"* remains **RETRACTED** | **MEASURED — STANDS** | `RESULT_WPH_TRUNK_VS_PIXELS.md` §WP-J |
| **D-TLANG-P43C-HOLD** | Any P4-3c-sourced statement that REF-C's trunk is *"at chance on `vru_ahead`"* is **INADMISSIBLE until re-measured** against the IN-FOV target. Not retracted — **not yet readable** | **HELD** | TRAIN-C13 |
| **D-TLANG-PORTS** | **The zero-init prior-port pattern is NOT inert on this architecture.** `refc-base-30k` carries `decoder.maneuver_to_anchor` `[128,5]` at **L2 6.375, max\|w\| 0.724** after 30 k steps — training moves it off zero. ⚠️ That checkpoint carries **only** this port; `lat_to_anchor` / `lon_to_anchor` / `lan_gate` are refcv3+ additions and are **absent** from the base | **MEASURED** | checkpoint weight audit, this turn |
| **H-TLANG-BRIDGE-1** | **A single learned compatibility energy `E(z, τ)`, read forward over the fan as `S₁ = S₀ − β·E` and read at the selected point as a consistency loss, makes INFLUENCE and CONSISTENCY separately measurable without a loop** — the reasoner reasons against the *base* fan `F₀` (which it cannot have caused) and is scored for consistency against `τ_sel` (which it did). ⛔ Both outcomes committed: **refuted** if `INF_kl ≈ 0` after stage A (energy constant in `z` ⇒ caption generator), and **refuted differently** if `INF` is large while the **shuffled-z** control fails to degrade `CON_rank` (⇒ a scene-blind random re-ranker, which can still improve ADE by luck — which is why that control is mandatory) | **OPEN — pre-registered, design banked before any arm exists** | `DIALOGUE_07_TANITLANG_ENERGY_BRIDGE.md` §1–§2, §10 |
| **H-TLANG-ECHO-1** | **A CoT is an echo iff it is reconstructible from the answer.** Operationalised as `echo_residual(z, τ)`: the fraction of `z`'s variance a linear map from `τ_sel` cannot explain. ⚠️ **The implication runs one way only** — a LOW residual proves echo; a HIGH residual proves only *not linearly reconstructible* and must name its function class (`CLAUDE.md`: a negative from a linear probe is not a negative about learnability) | **INSTRUMENT LANDED, unrun on a model** | `stack/tanitad/instruments/cot_influence.py::echo_residual`, 3 pinning tests |
| **H-TLANG-VOCAB-1** | **The tactical/strategic vocabularies and the LM's token vocabulary are ONE embedding table with two consumers** — `<TAC:…>` / `<STR:…>` special tokens whose rows are tied to the planner's `maneuver_emb`/goal rows, so *emitting the token IS conditioning the planner* through REF-C's existing zero-init prior ports. This is the PI's *"sharing the same embedding space"* made literal | **DESIGN — HYPOTHESIS** | `DIALOGUE_07` §5 |
| **H-TLANG-LANG-PATH** | **Language enters as a REGULARISER on `z` and an OPTIONAL renderer, never as a link in the control chain.** Control path is `image → cond₀ → z → E_φ → S₁`; the LM reads `z` and writes gradients into it. ⇒ the language-free arm is deployable at the 300–500 ms tact and the vision-only inference ruling is preserved | **DESIGN — HYPOTHESIS** | `DIALOGUE_07` §6 |

| **D-TLANG-DEFECT-9** | ⛔ **A pooled leave-one-episode-out AUC encoded fold identity**; the shuffled control read **0.7736** where it must read ~0.5. ⚠️ And the *gate* was also wrong — `\|x−0.5\| < 0.12` on a statistic whose own uncertainty was ≈ ±0.15, i.e. **a control read without its interval**. Replaced by a permutation test whose null is generated by the same pipeline | **MEASURED — FIXED** | RETRACTION_LOG TRAIN-C15 |
| **D-TLANG-AFFORD** | ⭐ **PROVENANCE PARITY IS NOT AFFORDANCE PARITY.** Seven specification defects in one campaign, all one shape: two things compared without the same affordances (features identical across candidates · a control judged against the wrong chance level · an arm denied the baseline's information · an effect test inside a validity gate · unhandled ties · unmatched pooling · **unmatched field of view**). ⇒ **before comparing, enumerate every affordance — spatial structure, dimensionality, temporal extent, field of view, information given — and assert parity on each** | **ADOPTED as a standing check** | RETRACTION_LOG TRAIN-C13 §generalisation |

⚠️ **Scope on the headroom that motivates all of this.** H-TL-1: SELECTED **0.654 m**, ORACLE **0.250 m**, headroom **0.404 m** CI95 [+0.267, +0.570] SEPARATED, best-anchor median rank **3/128**, top-5 **75.0 %** — but **T0, non-parity pilot, one seed, n=120**. A separated CI on a one-seed arm is **necessary and not sufficient** (`H-ESTIM-SEED-1`). It justifies building the experiment; it does not claim the bridge closes the gap.

### ⛔⛔ D-REFCV4B-ASTAR-GEOMETRY — `oracle_sel`, `anchor_acc` and `sel_agrees_oracle` are INVALID on refcv4b (NEW, this turn)
`refcv3_arm.py:1492` binds `anchors_bank = model.core.decoder.anchors` and uses it for the
`a_star` argmin (`:1657`, `:1665`). `refc_v3_train.py:538-545` **forbids exactly this** for a
v0-conditioned vocabulary — *"`decoder.anchors` is the family rolled at the REFERENCE SPEED, not
this window's fan … the model never emitted [it] — silently, and with `anchor_acc` still reading
plausibly"* — and the trainer itself uses `out["anchor_bank"]`.
**MEASURED with its control:** refcv4b's argv carries **`--anchor-v0-conditioned` (True, 56
entries, also `--anchors`)**; refcv3's does **NOT** (False, 43 entries, no `--anchors`).
⇒ **`oracle_sel` 1.2154 m reads +0.9179 [+0.8055, +1.0348] separated WORSE than `os` — a "ceiling"
4× above the arm it bounds is not a ceiling**, and `anchor_acc`/`sel_agrees_oracle` = 0.0993 are
scored against a geometry the model never emitted.
⭐ **It also explains an inversion that would otherwise read as a model regression:** refcv3's
`oracle_sel` **0.3668** genuinely *beat* its `os` 0.4419 (fixed vocabulary ⇒ the two banks
coincide, which the trainer calls *"unchanged arithmetic … verified bit-identical"*). **The
difference between the two rows is the INSTRUMENT, not the model.**
⚠️ **Scope: the headline is untouched** — no ADE, no LONGITUDINAL/LATERAL row and no
lateral/longitudinal decision reads `a_star`. Fix = compute `a_star` from `out["anchor_bank"]`
(~2 lines + a T0 re-roll). ⛔ **Until it lands, no refcv5 selector claim may rest on `anchor_acc`.**

### ⭐⭐ D-REFCV5-LEVERS — the VALIDATED improvement list, ranked by MEASURED effect size
1. **Encode CLOSING RATE** (`M84`: lead POSITION decodable **+0.4145 [+0.2018, +0.6120]** vs
   pixels, constant control exactly +0.000000; CLOSING RATE a clean null **+0.0061** on every arm,
   and a temporal difference recovers nothing). Corroborated three ways by this read: `os − ha`
   speed MAE +0.0368 separated worse; LON κ 0.5178 < `ha` 0.6071; **472 of 1,225** distance-keeping
   windows are actually closing. **A REPRESENTATION requirement — no cost re-weighting substitutes.**
2. **Feed the model's OWN predicted route instead of the supplied v7.2 ROUTE token** — the route-removal
   **robustness-ablation margin** is **0.1054 m separated** (`os_navzero − ha0_ext`) ⚠️ *(vocabulary
   corrected 2026-09-06: the nav token is a first-class ROUTE input per the PI ruling of 2026-09-04,
   NOT an “oracle”, and this is not a “deployment gap”; and see `H-NAVPRED-1` — **95.7 % of what
   `os_navzero` removes is the E13 conditioning vector's PRESENCE, only 4.3 % its CONTENT**, so the
   0.1054 m is a PATHWAY margin, not an information one)*, and **half-built already**: the route head predicts from
   vision at κ 0.4852 and passes its anti-echo control. Prefer a **geometric goal point** (+4.7
   PDMS) over the categorical command (+0.2). ⭐ Cheapest first step: an eval-time `os_navpred` arm
   on the existing checkpoint — **one GPU roll**, brackets the gain before any training.
3. **TRAIN the selector (WP-7); do NOT enable `--sel-refined`** (`M72`: **0.0259 m separated
   WORSE**, 30 % of picks flip, `seen_in_training: no`). New here: selection is concentrated —
   **50 of 117** anchors ever chosen, **modal anchor 48.79 %**, entropy ratio 0.4524.
   ⚠️ **Blocked on `D-REFCV4B-ASTAR-GEOMETRY` — the selector cannot be scored until `a_star` is correct.**
4. **Shape the path's CURVATURE, not its position** — curvature MAE above the straight-line floor
   while cross-track is the best of any arm. Cheapest test: a curvature-smoothed re-score of the
   banked dump, **zero GPU**.
5. **Repair or remove the longitudinal kin3 aux head** — the **EVAL-set** prior floor is
   **0.8421 nats** (measured this turn, `raw/refcv4b_kin3_marginal.json`; marginal [0.1613, 0.6844,
   0.1543], n = 4,823) against the trainer's eval CE **1.0090** ⇒ **0.1669 nats WORSE than
   predicting the class marginal**. Lateral floor 0.5199, and the lateral head does beat it.
   ⭐ Converts the preliminary's floor from a **TRAIN EMA** to a **MEASURED eval-set** one.
6. **H19 anchor prior — DE-PRIORITISE** (0.0034 m, NOT separated; 5.85 % of picks).
⛔ **NOT on the list: "more ego dropout."** refcv4b already ran `--ego-dropout 0.5` for 40,284
steps and its vision-only arm is still **3.8× worse**. A vision-derived longitudinal state is the
lever; more of the same knob is not.

## `D-REFAV1-DK-COST` — ⭐ **refav1's LONGITUDINAL DISTANCE-KEEPING COST: BUILT, FIRING, AND RE-RANKING** (2026-09-06)

**Package:** `TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-06-refav1-distance-keeping/`
(`RESULT.md`, `raw/dk_fire_probe.json`, `raw/dk_tau_calib.json`, `raw/dk_direction_full.json`,
`raw/smoke_out_dkw{0,1e-5}.json`, `raw/join_receipt.json`).
**Code:** `stack/tanitad/refs/refav1_lon_cost.py` (new) · hook in `refa_v1.plan` ·
`--dk-w/--dk-tau/--dk-d0/--dk-gap-source/--dk-gap-block` in `taniteval/tools/refav1_arm.py` ·
`stack/tests/test_refav1_lon_cost.py` (23) + `stack/tests/test_refa_v1_dk_hook.py` (9).

### ⛔ CORRECTION FIRST — "refav1 has never reported distance-keeping, n = 0" is REFUTED

**MEASURED:** `taniteval/results/RESULT-refav1-21109-openloop.md` has published it since
**2026-09-04**: `cl` headway **26.2149 m** / time-gap **4.6913 s** / min-TTC **22.9028 s**, with
`distance_keeping.status = "OK"`, **`n = 87`**, `n_time_gap = 81`, `n_closing = 39` and the full
per-speed-band stratification in `refav1-21109-openloop.json`. The wiring is
`taniteval/taniteval/lead_source.py` + `tools/build_lead_block_b1.py` + the banked **B1 EVAL lead
block** (29,556 rows / 147 clips), joined by `(clip_id, RAW frame 2t)`.
⚠️ **ROOT-CAUSE CLASS: a stale absence claim scoped to the WRONG CORPUS.**
`dump_lead_join.py`'s docstring records the true 2026-08-18 fact *"val40 ∩ train2308 = ∅"* — but
refav1 evaluates on the **141-clip v7.2 EVAL split**, for which a **different** block was built on
2026-09-02. Two corpora, one phrase ("the eval set"). Same family as the `physicalai` read-set
count that rotted four times: **an absence found at ONE location is not absence, and a claim about
a corpus must name the corpus.**
⚠️ **The 433,040-record / 2,308-clip agent join is REAL and RE-VERIFIED** (md5
**`24cbdca8c3b23aafc2fb17e6bf99cf76`** == the banked expected value, 136,689,648 B, at
`C:/Users/Admin/tanitad-data/joins/joins/train2400_agents.jsonl.xz`) — **but it is a TRAIN-corpus
join and cannot be attached to refav1's EVAL windows.** ⇒ **the `build_lead_tracks.py` adapter was
NOT built, deliberately**: it would have produced a join for the wrong corpus. Recorded as a
decision, not an omission (`raw/join_receipt.json`).
⭐ **TWO `n`s LIVE IN THIS FAMILY:** **90** = windows whose *causal lead selection at t0* found an
in-corridor vehicle (**what the COST sees**, before any path exists); **87** = windows where the
*arm's predicted path* keeps the lead in-corridor for ≥1 step (**what the METRIC scores**,
arm-dependent). Reproduced from the dump; `lead_metrics.distance_keeping(cl, …)` returns exactly
**87**. **Quote the cost's n for the cost and the metric's n for the metric.**

### The defect, as arithmetic

`_cost_chunk` prices the goal term, `w_jerk·mean(jerk²)`, `w_kappa·mean(κ²)`, and `w_vend` **only
when `target_speed` is armed — which `refav1_arm.py` never does**. `mean(jerk²)` is **0 for ANY
constant acceleration**; `mean(κ²)` says nothing about speed. ⇒ **the all-zero control is the joint
minimiser and the acceleration channel had NO cost at all.** MEASURED on the 21109 panel: `cl`
bit-identical to `ha0` on **270/282**, κ identically zero on **282/282**, two distinct plans total,
and the whole cost landscape is `plan_cost_cl` **median 0.0, max 1.41e-04**.

### The term, and the coordinate it is expressible in

`cost_dk = w_dk · mean_k( relu(s*(v_k) − gap_k)² )`, `s*(v) = d0 + tau·v`,
`gap_k = gap0 + v_lead·t_k − s_ego(t_k)`. A function of **exactly two things**: **`gap0`** (the one
perception input, which `H-REFAV1-PERCEPT-1` measured is decodable from this planner's own
`_last_state` at **+0.3632 [+0.2069, +0.5088]** vs a **−0.0513** raw-pixel floor) and the
**candidate's own kinematics**, integrated with `rollout_unicycle`'s convention *exactly* and
pinned numerically against the integrator, so the cost's gap **is** the gap
`lead_metrics.per_step_gap` scores.
⛔⛔ **THE CLOSURE IS AN ASSUMPTION AND IT IS NAMED:** M84's closing-rate null (`field` +0.0061
[−0.0406, +0.0513]; and the cheap fix — an explicit temporal difference — recovers **+0.0145, still
spanning zero**) means the lead's future speed is **unobservable**, so it is closed at
`v_lead = v0`. The predicted gap then depends **only** on the candidate's excess displacement over
constant velocity and is **exactly `gap0` for a = 0**. ⇒ **this term prices a GAP; it CANNOT price
CLOSING**, and the closure travels into every dump.
⚠️ **IDM-shaped, because a threshold carries its regime (M74):** `gap/v ≥ tau` is undefined at
v → 0 and rates a 1 m gap at 0.5 m/s as a 2 s headway. `d0` carries the crawl, `tau` the cruise.
⚠️ **One-sided and saturating**, so it can never reward closing a large gap nor reward braking past
adequacy. ⛔ **Default-OFF and EXACTLY zero** on the shipped path (test-pinned, each parity
assertion paired with a same-breath control that MUST differ).

### MEASURED — it fires, it re-ranks, and the human goes the same way

* **P1 (zero-GPU re-pricing of the banked 21109 panel).** Of **90** LEAD windows, **21 (23.3 %,
  17 episodes) are in violation** at `tau = 1.5`; mean shortfall **9.10 m** (max 27.48), violating
  v0 **16.44 m/s** vs adequate **8.00**. **Controls read their known values:** adequate cost
  **exactly 0.0** (an identity), violating **strictly > 0**, unarmed **exactly 0**.
* **P2 (re-rank).** On the planner's constant-acceleration baselines **both existing regularisers
  are identically zero and `w_vend` was never armed ⇒ the DK term is the ONLY discriminator**:
  cost(a=0) **143.373** vs cost(a=−1.5) **100.034** ⇒ **21/21 flip** from hold-speed to decelerate.
* ⛔ **P2's direction check was a NULL** (tau 1.5: −0.2015 [−0.4455, +0.0446], spans 0) — and the
  null was about the **panel**, not the corpus: `--window-stride 40` emits **2 windows/episode**, so
  21 violating windows over 17 episodes cannot settle it. **UNDERPOWERED, reported as such.**
* ⭐ **P3 — RUN WHERE IT HAS POWER, AND IT PASSES.** The same question on the **full B1 eval lead
  block: 8,339 usable LEAD rows / 147 clips at 10 Hz**, GT acceleration from the block's own
  per-frame `speeds`, clip-cluster bootstrap. **A clean interior optimum at tau ≈ 1.2–1.5** in the
  leakage-immune **EXCESS (TRUE − within-clip SHUFFLE)**: **−0.2120** (tau 1.2; raw −0.3002
  [−0.5423, −0.1217]) and **−0.2053** (tau 1.5; raw −0.2617 [−0.4531, −0.0991]), both raw CIs
  excluding zero. ⛔ **The within-clip shuffle is NOT zero anywhere (−0.031 to −0.148)** — clips with
  many tight-gap rows are also braking clips — **so the EXCESS is the readable quantity, never the
  raw delta** (M84's agent-count lesson). ⚠️ **tau = 0.8 FAILS while 0.5 and 1.0 pass**; reported as
  it came out, not smoothed.
* ⭐ **The corpus agrees from the other side:** time gap at t0 (n = 7,211 rows / 86 clips, v ≥ 1 m/s)
  **median 2.917 s / p25 1.894 / p10 1.316**; at **v ≥ 10 m/s** (n = 3,218) **median 2.056 / p25
  1.371 / p10 0.886**. ⇒ **`tau = 1.5 s` sits at ~p25 of the at-speed distribution against a median
  of 2.06 s — it prices the TAIL and does not fight the reference the arm is scored against.**

### ⭐ P4 — THE DEGENERACY BROKE ON THE REAL CHECKPOINT (T1, dev-box RTX 4060, step 21,109)

Same seed, same flags, `--dk-w` the only difference, on the 2 slice episodes carrying a violating
eval-grid window. **n = 4 windows / 2 episodes.**

|---|---|---|

⭐ **First time refav1's acceleration channel has been priced at all.** Direction correct (headway
+0.045 m, min-TTC +0.137 s); **lateral bit-identical** — a same-breath control proving the term
touches only the longitudinal channel.
⛔⛔ **WHAT THIS IS NOT:** n = 4 carries **no** family claim, and the ADE move (**+0.2303 m**) is
**BELOW refav1's ≈0.30 m inference-seed floor** (`D-REFAV1-SEED-GOAL-MISMATCH`) — **so it is not an
effect.** Only the two structural rows stand, and only as identities about this fixed-seed pair:
const-velocity 1.0000 → 0.7500 and identical-to 4/4 → 3/4 are **exact-equality counts with one flag
moved**.
⚠️ **THE GAP IS AN ORACLE LABEL ⇒ THIS IS A CEILING**, answering the question `M53`/`M54` left open
when a *perfect goal* made this planner **2.03× worse**. `--dk-gap-source` accepts **only**
`oracle_label` and the tool **refuses** any other value rather than banking an arm whose record
would misdescribe its input.

## ⭐ H-REFCV5-DDIM-1 — **PRE-REGISTERED, NOT RUN: the WP-4 control-space DDIM sampler, with the INFERENCE-seed replicate the rig demands** (2026-09-06, Arch+Inference FlyWheel, 0 GPU)

⛔⛔ **NO refcv5 RESULT EXISTS.** `refcv5-ddim-b1-v72-40k` is training on `tanitad-a40`
(launched 2026-09-06 10:13:52 UTC, 4.046 s/step over 34 intervals, ETA ≈ 2026-09-08 07:33 UTC, `D-REFCV5-LAUNCH-1`; ⚠ the launch record's single-interval 3.938 s/step ⇒ 06:20 UTC is SUPERSEDED).
This row registers the hypothesis and its **committed** PASS/FAIL criteria **before the data
exists**, which is the only moment a pre-registration is worth anything.
**SPEC:** `TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-06-refcv5-landing-prereg/SPEC.md`
(all sections). **Analysis, written now and self-tested:** `raw/refcv5_landing_analysis.py`,
`raw/mkfixture.py`, `raw/selftest.log`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Hypothesis** | replacing refcv4b's truncated-diffusion refinement loop with the **DDIM sampler in CONTROL space** (`--sampler ddim` + its **mandatory** `--w-u0 0.5`) improves driving on the same B1 surface — *"every sample re-rolls through the kinematic model and is flyable by construction rather than by penalty."* |
| **one_variable** | ⭐ **ONE MECHANISM, INSEPARABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** `U0_WEIGHT_DEFAULT = 0.0` (`refc_v3_train.py:114`); `--sampler ddim --w-u0 0` is **REFUSED** (`:302-309`); a stamp with `w_u0 > 0` and no `control_head` is **REFUSED** (`:2113-2115`). `--agents off` is the **default** (`:3400`) and changes nothing. `--sampler-space control` / `-infer-t 8` / `-steps 2` / `-groups 1` are all defaults, unpassed. And `refc.py:2107` sets `_loop_steps = 0` when the sampler is built, so the pre-v5 loop is **disabled** and exactly one mechanism refines the fan. **G-ARGV** asserts the `config.json['argv']` symmetric difference is exactly `{--sampler ddim, --w-u0 0.5, --agents off}` or the panel is **VOID** |
| ⭐ **PASS (P1) — the ONLY criterion that decides "progress"** | **`refcv5 os − ha0_ext` on `ade_m` is NEGATIVE, its paired CI excludes zero, and `|delta| > F(ade_m)`** — F being refcv5's OWN measured inference floor. **This is the bar refcv4b FAILED** (`os − ha0_ext` **+0.0101** [−0.0050, +0.0273], not separated) |
| **PARTIAL (P2)** | `refcv5 os − refcv4b os` separated NEGATIVE and > floor **while P1 does not hold** ⇒ reported as **`LEVER-SUPPORTED / NOT-DRIVING`**. ⛔ Beating refcv4b while still only tying `ha0_ext` (0.2874) and `ha` (0.2996) **is not driving** — it is a delta between two ties |
| **FAIL (F1 NULL)** | `refcv5 os − refcv4b os` not separated, **or** `|delta| ≤ F(ade_m)` ⇒ a 44-hour arm whose one mechanism moved nothing a second roll of the same checkpoint would not have moved by itself |
| **FAIL (F2 REGRESSION)** | separated POSITIVE ⇒ the next lever is the ladder (`--sampler-infer-t` / `--sampler-steps`), not more training |

### ⭐ BAR-1 — DECODE: **PASS**

5-fold **cross-fitting** over the 141-clip v7.2 EVAL corpus, clip-disjoint, label-free fold
assignment (sha256 of `clip_id`); stage-A PCA, stage-B PCA, ridge λ and the fit-mean all fit
**inside the training folds only**, every scored prediction **out-of-fold**. Bank: 141 clips /
**14,237 rows / 3,991 LEAD rows**; freeze **407 tensors, 0 sha mismatches, max |Δ| = 0
exactly**; label-free alignment true join **3.20e-05 m/s** against a deliberate **one-step
mis-join control at 1.24 m/s max / 0.095 m/s mean**.

⭐ The head **collapses exactly to one dot product** `gap_hat = (pool(_last_state)·V).sum() + b`
per fold; the collapse is **checked numerically on every fold — max relative error 2.74e-07 over
15 folds** — and a relative error > 1e-4 is a refusal.

### ⛔⛔ THE CONTROL THAT CHANGED THE CEILING'S INTERPRETATION — and it is the finding

**A gap predictor with NO PERCEPTION AT ALL reproduces 11 of the oracle's 21 flips.** The
barrier is `gap < d0 + tau·v0`, so a constant gap makes the firing decision a pure **speed
threshold**, and the violating windows are the fast ones (16.44 m/s vs 8.00 m/s).

| arm (identical procedure) | sensitivity | specificity |
|---|---|---|
| `oracle_label` (CEILING) | 21/21 = 1.0000 | 69/69 = 1.0000 |
| ⭐ `field` decoded | **16/21 = 0.7619** | 61/69 = 0.8841 |
| `pix` raw-pixel floor | 13/21 = 0.6190 | 61/69 = 0.8841 |
| ⛔ `constant` — no perception | **11/21 = 0.5238** | 64/69 = 0.9275 |

⇒ **"the term re-ranks 21/21" is a correct statement about the term that is roughly half a
statement about `v0`.** The CEILING's arithmetic is unchanged and reproduces exactly; its
*interpretation* is corrected. ⭐ And at **matched specificity 0.8841** the decode is worth
**+3 windows over raw pixels and +5 over no perception** — the information is real.

### ⭐ THE TRADE-OFF CURVE, and why no single point is quoted

Offsets fit as the `q`-quantile of the **training-fold** residual; every arm swept identically.
⛔ **NO arm clears BAR-2 at ANY operating point** — not `field`, not `pix`, not `constant`.
⭐ `field` − `constant` at **matched specificity**: **+0.3333** (at 0.9855), ⭐ **+0.3810** (at
0.8841), +0.1905 (at 0.5942), **+0.0000** (at 0.3623 — once everything fires, the decode is
worth nothing). ⚠️ Choosing an operating point needs a safety criterion the programme has not
committed to; picking the one that clears a bar after seeing the data is a goalpost move.

**Shrinkage:** `truth = 1.362 + 0.896·pred`, spread ratio **0.724**; ⛔ **bias +8.36 m on gaps
< 30 m** (thinks the lead is further than it is ⇒ **under-fires** — the unsafe half) against
−7.61 m on gaps ≥ 30 m. A per-fold recalibration fit on **training folds only** moved
sensitivity 12/21 → 14/21 → 16/21 (median debias) at unchanged specificity, costing R²
(0.4040 → 0.3925) exactly as trading squared error for spread should. **It does not clear the
bar.**

it too (13/16 = 0.8125 at the same 0.7436) and the constant nearly does (12/16 at 0.7692).**
⇒ **on the ≤ 30 m subset the bar is not a discriminating instrument**, because restricting to
near range removes exactly the windows a constant gets wrong. A subset can be easy the same way
an operating point can be.

### ⭐ BAR-4 — THE PROVENANCE GUARD: **PASS, PROVEN BY MUTATION**

The gap-source field was a **free-form string**: any value was accepted and stamped into the
dump verbatim, so a typo or an optimistic label would have been **banked as fact**. ⛔ The fix
for *"the decoded head does not exist yet"* was never to relax the refusal — the vocabulary is
now **CLOSED** (`oracle_label` · `decoded_gap` · `decoded` · `unit-test` · `unset`), each member
stamped with `gate` / `gap` / `vision_only` / `is_ceiling` / `needs_head`, and an unrecognised
source **raises**. `GapHeadProvenance` (head sha256, version, ckpt sha256 + step, fit corpus,
fit scheme, n rows/clips, pooling geometry) is **mandatory for a decoded source and FORBIDDEN
for an oracle one** — the second direction matters more, because an oracle arm stamped with a
head reads like a vision result.
**26 tests, each guard in a PAIR**: the bad input raises, *and* with the guard's own datum
mutated the same input is accepted — which is what proves the refusal came from the guard under
test. *(An AST census once read 0 suspects on BOTH the fixed and the broken trainer.)* The arm
additionally refuses a head whose `ckpt_sha256`/step/`d_state`/geometry disagree with the running
checkpoint, and refuses a clip with **no out-of-fold head** rather than guessing a fold.

### ⛔ THE ADMISSIBILITY CHECK, ANSWERED IN BOTH HALVES

The head's only inference input is `model._last_state(model.encode(feats))` — the cached DINOv3
patch-token window, **camera pixels and nothing else**, taken from the **same `feats` tensor the
next line hands to `plan()`**. The label `gap0_m` derives from `obstacle.offline` **3-D cuboid
tracks**, which are **not an input to the trunk at any stage** ⇒ the head cannot be reading its
label's own source. ⛔ **BUT THE SECOND HALF: `oracle_label` and `decoded_gap` take their
LEAD/NO_LEAD ARMING GATE from the label and are NOT vision-only, however good their gap is.**
Only `decoded` is, and the module stamps exactly that. ⚠️ `v0` enters the **cost** (not the
head) and is admissible under the PI's binding ruling of 2026-09-02 — named explicitly here
because the constant control shows how much of the firing decision it carries. ⛔ **No closing
rate was smuggled in**: the head predicts gap and presence only.

## 2026-09-06 — the effective weight is not the argparse default (effective-weight stream)

**Package:** `TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-06-effective-weights/`
(`EFFECTIVE_WEIGHTS.md`). Code: `stack/tanitad/effective_weights.py` (new),
`stack/scripts/train_v6_staged.py`, `stack/scripts/refc_v3_train.py`,
`stack/tests/test_v6_effective_weights.py` (new, **35 tests, all passing**).
⛔ **NO EVAL TIER APPLIES TO ANY ROW BELOW AND NONE IS A DRIVING NUMBER** — this is a *launch-time*
instrument. Nothing was trained, nothing was evaluated, and ⛔ **no weight was changed**: flipping a
default silently changes the recipe every banked arm was trained under.

| id | claim | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D-EFFW-1** | ⛔⛔ **AN OPERATOR'S EXPLICIT LAUNCH FLAG WAS SILENTLY DISCARDED.** `V6LossWeights.for_stage(stage)` rewrites the argparse defaults per stage, so `--stage S-T --w-o5 1.0` **trains nothing on O5** while stamping `w_o5: 1.0` into `config.json`. ⭐ **This is the mechanism behind the already-measured v7f defect** — *42 of 138 optimizer tensors took no gradient, 5,305,667 params = **52.2 %** of a declared trainable budget* — because a zero-weighted term is **guarded out** of the loss and its modules never enter the autograd graph. ⭐ **`p.grad is None` is the sound discriminator; the weight's value never was** | **MEASURED (ours), 0 GPU** | `EFFECTIVE_WEIGHTS.md` §1; `train_v6_staged.py::for_stage` |
| **D-EFFW-2** | ⚠️ **THE STAGE-ZEROING ENUMERATION THIS WORK STARTED FROM WAS INCOMPLETE, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS.** MEASURED by pushing an all-1.0 probe through the real `for_stage`: **S-W 10**, **S-T 10** — *not the nine reported; `w_s1_multi` was missed* — **S-S 14** (*not enumerated at all, and the largest set*), **S-J 0**. ⭐ The guard therefore **derives** its table from `for_stage` itself rather than copying it: a hand-copied list is a second source of truth, and this programme has measured the copy rotting **four times** (the "2 of 36 features" count, inside the rule warning about stale counts) | **MEASURED (ours)** | `test_v6_effective_weights.py::test_the_measured_zeroing_counts` |
| **D-EFFW-3** | ⭐ **"EXPLICIT" IS READ FROM `argv`, NEVER FROM THE VALUE — and that distinction is load-bearing, not stylistic.** `--w-o5 1.0` **passes the default value**, so a value comparison cannot tell an operator's request from silence, yet the two must produce **opposite** verdicts. `explicit_dests()` re-parses the same command line against a parser whose defaults are unique sentinels (exact for `--flag=value`, abbreviations, `nargs`, `store_true`; the live parser's defaults are restored). ⛔ **A default of 0.0 is FINE** and ⛔ **a stage zeroing a term the operator never mentioned is the ladder working as designed** — only a value the operator **ASKED FOR** being discarded is refused | **MEASURED (ours)** | `test_explicitness_comes_from_argv_and_not_from_the_value` |
| **D-EFFW-4** | ⭐ **TWO-SIDED MUTATION PROOF, 16/16.** v6 **8/8**: `--w-o5`/`--w-o1-ctrl`/`--w-s1-multi` on S-T and `--w-t1` on S-W **REFUSE**; the *same* `--w-o5 1.0` on **S-J** (which keeps the term), a **silent** S-T launch, an explicit `--w-o5 0`, and the acknowledged override all **PASS**. refc **8/8**, including ⛔ **the LIVE `refcv5-ddim-b1-v72-40k` command (`--sampler ddim --w-u0 0.5 --agents off`), which PASSES** — the A40 resume is not broken. ⭐ *A guard that refuses everything gets deleted; one that refuses nothing measured nothing* | **MEASURED (ours)** | `EFFECTIVE_WEIGHTS.md` §3 |
| **D-EFFW-5** | ⛔⛔ **CORRECTNESS AND WIRING ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS, AND IN `refc_v3_train.py` THE GAP IS REAL:** `main` runs `preflight` **ONLY** under `--preflight` and otherwise calls `train(args)` directly — so a guard wired into `preflight` alone covers **one launch path of two**. That is why every existing guard there (`_check_nav_from_v7_args`, `_check_goal_point_args`, `_read_anchor_artifact`, `_check_anchor_artifact_against_cfg`) is **double-called**, and the new one is too. In v6, `main` gates **both** `train` and `dry_run` behind `preflight`: MEASURED by monkeypatching both entry points — a `DISCARDED` launch returns **2** and **neither** is entered, on the real path and under `--dry-run` | **MEASURED (ours)** | `test_refc_guard_is_on_the_real_path`, `test_preflight_is_on_every_v6_launch_path` |
| **D-EFFW-6** | ⚠️ **A MASKED TERM IS NOT A DEAD TERM, AND THE TABLE MUST SAY WHICH.** A zero loss has **four** possible sources — the argparse weight, a stage override, a missing structural precondition, or an **all-invalid batch** — and conflating them manufactures false alarms, which is worse than the silence being replaced. MEASURED: `--stage S-S --w-s2-goal 1.0 --s2-labels …` reads `TRAINS_IF_MASK` / `builds_graph=True` / `mask=s2_valid`, while the **same weight on S-T** reads `DISCARDED` / `builds_graph=False`. ⭐ Precedent this encodes: the route head's apparent zero gradient was a **validity mask, not a dead head** — forcing `route_valid=True` moved the loss **0.0 → 0.687** | **MEASURED (ours)** | `test_a_masked_term_is_distinguished_from_a_zeroed_one` |
| **D-EFFW-7** | ⭐ **`config.json` NOW CARRIES ITS EFFECTIVE WEIGHTS.** Per term: argparse default → what the operator asked → **which layer changed it** → effective → whether the operator typed it → **whether it builds a graph** → its mask → its missing precondition, plus `explicit_source` and `acknowledged_discarded`. Stamped from `_run_config`, the **one** builder both the dry-run and the real v6 path use, so it cannot be present on one path and missing on the other. ⛔ A run record that does not carry its effective weights cannot be audited afterwards, and **three arm-substitutions have already been found in this programme** | **MEASURED (ours)** | `EFFECTIVE_WEIGHTS.md` §9 |
| **D-EFFW-8** | ⚠️ **HONEST SCOPE ON refc: THERE WAS NO LIVE HOLE, AND SAYING OTHERWISE WOULD MANUFACTURE A DEFECT.** refc has exactly **five** weight-like flags (`--w-u0`, `--w-agent`, `--agent-w-project`, `--agent-w-ground`, `--goal-point-w`) and **all five were already gated**. The new layer earns its place by (1) **failing earlier** — `w_u0 > 0` with no `control_head` was caught only by `assert_seams_are_built`, *after* the corpus mounts and the model builds; (2) making the record auditable; (3) ⛔ **`REFC_WEIGHT_GATES` being EXHAUSTIVE over the parser**, so the next `--w-*` cannot ship ungated. ⛔ No `--allow-discarded-weights` was added there — refc has no stage layer, and a flag that can never fire is not a feature | **MEASURED (ours)** | `test_REFC_WEIGHT_GATES_covers_every_weight_flag_the_parser_accepts` |
| **D-EFFW-9** | ⭐ **INCONCLUSIVE #1 RESOLVED — IT WAS A WRONG-FILE PROBE, NOT AN UNREADABLE FILE.** `refc_agents.py`'s "unreadable" sub-weights are **not in that file at all**: `agent_losses` delegates to `slot_set_loss` in **`stack/tanitad/models/agent_slots.py`**, where `SLOT_LOSS_W = {presence 1.0, cls 1.0, centre 1.0, size 1.0, yaw 1.0, rates 0.5, occ 0.5}` and `NO_OBJECT_W = 0.1`. **None is 0.0** (so none is advertised-but-inert) and **none is operator-reachable** — `refc_v3_train.py` calls `agent_losses(…)` **without `weights=`** — so they are constants, not launch flags, and correctly outside this audit. They are already mask-disciplined: every term is reported **with its `n`**, and *"a term with `n == 0` is reported as 0.0 WITH its count, never dropped"*. ⚠️ **Root-cause class: absence found at ONE location is not absence** | **MEASURED (ours)** | `models/agent_slots.py::SLOT_LOSS_W`; `refc_v3_train.py` `agent_losses` call site |
| **D-EFFW-10** | ⭐ **INCONCLUSIVE #2 RESOLVED — `refa_v1_train.py` ENUMERATED (⛔ NOT EDITED; outside this stream's ownership).** Three weight flags, all defaulting `0.0`: **`--w-cf`** is gated by `sanity()` in **`refa_v1.py`** (a *model* method, which is why `grep "def sanity"` on the trainer reads 0) — it refuses `cf_negs < 1` with the words *"the term would be advertised in the launch line and inert in the loss"*, **this defect class verbatim**; **`--w-sigreg`** is ungated but **correctly so** — self-contained, no external target; ⚠️ **`--w-aux-head`** has bounds only and a `SystemExit` that fires **only under `--smoke`**. Its source records the original defect — `out["loss"] + cfg.w_aux_head * torch.zeros(())`, *"the config carries `w_aux_head 0.1` … and the term contributes EXACTLY nothing"*. The claim that it is live under a real `--cache` is **INHERITED, not re-verified**; verifying it is a one-arm `p.grad is not None` probe for that file's owner | **MEASURED (ours) for the enumeration; INHERITED for the "live under a real cache" claim** | `EFFECTIVE_WEIGHTS.md` §8.2 |

⭐ **What this stream does NOT establish.** (1) **No driving claim and no capability claim —
nothing was trained or evaluated**, so no T-tier and no metric family applies. (2) ⛔ **No weight
was changed**; where a zero weight looks worth trying it is named as a *candidate arm with its
cost* (`w_s2_goal` on S-S/S-J, `w_t2_contrast` on S-T, `o10_psg` with its join) and **not enabled**
— each still needs its own pre-registration with both outcomes committed, and a **replicate arm**
per `H-ESTIM-SEED-1`. (3) The audit covers `train_v6_staged.py` and `refc_v3_train.py` **only**:
⚠️ **an operator CAN still pass a weight that trains nothing elsewhere** — `refa_v1_train.py`'s
`--w-aux-head` is gated only under `--smoke`, and any trainer outside these two is unaudited.
(4) The guard refuses at **launch**; it does not verify gradient actually flowed — that remains
`p.grad is None` at runtime, which the audit names but does not replace.

## D-REFCV5-REDESIGN-DEFECTS — six defects found while auditing refcv5's flag surface for the redesign (2026-09-06, Arch+Inference FlyWheel, 0 GPU)

**Package:** `TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-06-refcv5-redesign/`
(extends `D-REFCV5-REDESIGN`). ⛔ **NO EVAL TIER APPLIES AND NONE IS A DRIVING NUMBER** —
these are source-level wiring facts. **Method:** AST inventory of `refc_v3_train.py`
(83 flags; reconciled against `str.count("add_argument")` = 84 minus exactly one
`add_argument_group`), plus whole-tree byte probes in which the **readability gap was closed
to zero** (22 files initially unreadable with `Errno 22` — the mount trap — **all 22 retried
to readable**), every negative carrying ≥2 mechanisms and a same-breath **non-zero** control.

| id | claim | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D-REFCV5-TRAINT-INERT** | ⛔⛔ **`--sampler-train-t-max` HAS NO CONSUMER — DD's `t ~ U[0, 50)` TRAINING DRAW IS NOT IMPLEMENTED.** Whole-tree probe: `refc.py` ×1 (**the dataclass field only**), `refc_v3_train.py` ×2 (assignment + argparse), **nothing reads it**. `AnchoredDiffusionDecoder._sample` has **no `self.training` branch** and uses `sampler_infer_t` at train **and** eval. ⇒ **refcv5 stamped `sampler_train_t_max: 50` into `config.json` and trained at `t = 8`**, while DD deliberately trains across `t ∈ [0, 49]` and infers from a much cleaner `t = 8`. ⭐ **This is the M18 dead-flag defect in the very arm whose launch record celebrated passing the M18 check on `w_u0`** — the check was run on one weight, not on the seam | **MEASURED (ours), 0 GPU** | `SPEC.md` item 1; escalation **E6** |
| **D-REFCV5-STEPS-SHADOWED** | ⚠️ **`--sampler-steps` IS SHADOWED and reachable only when `steps == 0`.** `k = int(steps) if int(steps) > 0 else int(cfg.sampler_steps)`, and the trainer always passes `steps` from `diffusion_steps`. Both are **2** today so behaviour is unchanged — ⛔ but the flag is **inert**, and a future ladder rung sweeping it would sweep nothing | **MEASURED (ours)** | escalation **E6** |
| **D-REFCV5-RANKS-THE-UNSAMPLED-FAN** | ⛔⛔ **refcv5 ADDED STOCHASTIC SAMPLING AND THEN RANKED THE SAMPLED FAN WITH A SCORE COMPUTED BEFORE ANY SAMPLE WAS DRAWN.** `refc.py` stamps `"sampler_ranks_the_fan": bool(self.sel.refined)` and `sel_refined` defaults **False** with **no CLI flag in the refcv5 trainer** — while the mechanism **is** implemented in `RefCConfig` and the flag **is** registered in the legacy `stack/scripts/refc_train.py`. ⇒ **the correct statement is not "the flag does not exist" but "the refcv5 trainer cannot arm a lever its own core implements."** `refc.py` prices ranking with an unrefined score at **>2× worse than the fan-best pick on 41.09 % of windows (base) / 45.4 % (REF-C-XL)**. ⛔ **This does NOT license flipping the flag** — `D-REFCV4B-SELREF-1` measured the untrained readout **separated WORSE (−0.0259 m)**; it makes DD #8 (per-layer deep supervision) + #28 (score the emitted fan) **one work item**, and the sampler's natural companion | **MEASURED (ours), 4 mechanisms** | `REVIEW.md` §2.3; escalation **E5** |
| **D-REFC-HAS-NO-GOALHEAD-TAC** | ⛔⛔ **"`goal_head_tac` IS ALREADY 22 WIDE ⇒ A PLUMBING GAP" IS FALSE FOR REF-C — IT IS A PLUMBING GAP *AND* AN ARCHITECTURE GAP.** MEASURED, all four files read successfully: **`goal_head_tac` = 0 in `refc_v3_train.py`, `refc_v3.py`, `refc.py` and `v7_labels.py`**; it lives in **`stack/tanitad/models/v6.py` (×25)** — it is a **v6** head, and 22-wide only at `v7.0` via `TACTICAL_GOAL_VOCAB_VERSIONS`. ⇒ **there is no head in the REF-C line to receive these tokens.** Two further corrections: `TACTICAL_GOAL_TOKENS_V7` is **not defined in `v7_labels.py`** (it is in `models/vocab_v7.py`, and `v7_labels.py` does not import it), and `HEADS` has exactly **four** entries (`tac_lat`, `tac_lon`, `str_action`, `str_goal`). ⚠️ **And the goal set is MULTI-LABEL — a set per window, not a class — so it is not a softmax head like the other four: adding it is a DESIGN DECISION, not a one-line dict edit.** ⭐ The audit-only routing is confirmed exactly as previously registered (`_goal_audit` keeps only metadata; the token survives merely as a dict key; `V7Label` says *"audit-only, NEVER a training input (spec §6)"*) | **MEASURED (ours), byte probes** | `SPEC.md` item 6; escalation **E2** (now **five** missing pieces, not one) |
| **D-REFCV5-ORACLE-UNRUNNABLE** | ⛔⛔ **`--agents oracle` IS NOT MERELY INADMISSIBLE — IT IS UNRUNNABLE FROM THIS TRAINER, AND THE GUARD'S OWN REMEDY RECOMMENDS IT.** `agent_gt` appears in `refc.py` (9), `refc_v3.py` (10), `rl/refc_adapter.py` (7), `rl/channel_guard.py` (2) and four test files — and **0 times in `refc_v3_train.py`**, read successfully in the same pass (control: it reports non-zero for `sampler_train_t_max` and `control_norm`). The trainer's only forward is `model(frames, nav_cmd=…, v0=…, steps=…, lan=…, ego_state=…)`. ⇒ the oracle's forward-time `ValueError` fires **regardless of `--agent-join`**; there is **no pin-time guard for oracle at all**; and the `--agents head` guard's remedy text says *"or `--agents oracle`"* — **a remedy that cannot work**. ⭐ **Consequence for the redesign: `--agents head` is not merely the admissible choice, it is the ONLY runnable one** — which also happens to be the DD-faithful one (`D-DDV1-AGENT-TOKENS-ARE-A-LEARNED-HEAD`) | **MEASURED (ours), source + call-graph trace** | `SPEC.md` item 2; escalation **E7** |
| **D-GOALPOINT-IS-CARTESIAN** | ⭐ **THE GOAL-POINT ENCODING CARRIES RANGE NATIVELY, AND NO FLAG CAN STRIP IT.** `stack/tanitad/refs/goal_point.py`: `GOAL_POINT_FEATS = 3`, and the injected vector is **Cartesian, not polar** — `[clip(x/40, ±4.0), clip(y/40, ±1.0), valid]` — with `range_norm_m = 40.0` a **FIXED constant**, the docstring being explicit it is fixed *"so the ego speed never enters the conditioning"*. ⇒ **range is not a separable component; it is the magnitude of `x`.** The `+2.3632 m` range-stripped penalty (`D-GOALPOINT-VALUE-IS-RANGE`, `raw/GP_LONG_AXIS_t4.json`) is an **eval-side probe result, not a flag**, so a bearing-only arm must be **built** as a deliberate eval-time intervention. ⭐ Also confirmed: `GoalPointHead` is `nn.Linear(d_ctx, 2)` from strategic context (**vision only, by construction**); `GoalPointConditioning` is **zero-init** and multiplied by the validity bit, so a goal-less window contributes **exactly zero**, not the encoder's bias; and there are **four** refusals in `_check_goal_point_args`, including a leak guard enforced both in the trainer and in `GoalPointConfig.__post_init__` | **MEASURED (ours)** | `SPEC.md` item 4 |
| **D-REFCV5-TACVOCAB-HARDCODED** | ⚠️ **`tac_vocab_version` IS A HARDCODED LITERAL AND NEVER PROPAGATES THE VALIDATED BLOB VERSION** — `cfg.tac_vocab_version = ("v7.0" if args.v7_labels else "kin3")`. `v7_labels.py` separately validates `EXPECTED_VOCAB = 'v7'` / `EXPECTED_SCHEMA = 's2-geom-v7'` against the blob and refuses a mismatch, but **that validated value is never used**. ⇒ refcv5's record stamps `tac_vocab_version: "v7.0"` while training on **v7.2** labels. There is no `--tac-vocab-version` flag (0 occurrences, control live). ⭐ Explains the stamp discrepancy without inventing a corpus problem | **MEASURED (ours)** | escalation **E8** |
| **D-REFCV5-KIN3-IS-CATEGORICAL** | ⚠️ **THE "LONGITUDINAL kin3 HEAD" IS A 3-WAY CATEGORICAL MANOEUVRE HEAD, NOT A GAP HEAD** — `LON_CLASSES = ("brake_stop", "steady", "accelerate")`, `nn.Linear(aux_hidden, 3)`. ⛔ **Nothing in the kin3 path reads a lead vehicle or a distance**, and **no CLI flag controls its weight** (`LON_WEIGHT` is an imported module constant); only `--v7-labels` changes its vocabulary. ⭐ **This supports rather than weakens the starvation hypothesis** in `H-REFCV5-CAP-1`: a head asked for a longitudinal decision from a trunk in which closing rate is a clean null (**+0.0061**) has no signal to use, and `--agents head` is what would supply one | **MEASURED (ours)** | `SPEC.md` item 10 |
| **D-REFAV1-DK-IS-METRES-ONLY** | ⭐ **THE DISTANCE-KEEPING COST IS DIMENSIONALLY INCAPABLE OF PRICING CLOSING, AND SAYS SO IN SOURCE.** `w_dk · mean_k( relu(s*(v_k) − gap_k)² )` with an IDM-affine desired gap `s*(v) = d0 + τ·v` **in metres** and a predicted gap that is a **position difference** — every term entering the penalty has units of metres, so the penalty is `relu(m − m)²`. The module states it as a design fact: *"this term CANNOT price closing, and does not pretend to."* Default off (`DK_W = 0.0`). ⚠️ **The smuggling risk is real and located:** a rate term **does** exist in `stack/tanitad/rl/rewards.py` (`closing = (gap[…, :-1] − gap[…, 1:]) / dt` + a TTC veto), but it is a **hard veto** consumed by `refc_selector_targets.py`, **not by the trainer** ⇒ **the trainer carries no rate term by ABSENCE, not by design** — which is exactly the condition under which one gets added by accident | **MEASURED (ours)** | `SPEC.md` item 9 |

⚠️ **Scope, stated rather than glossed.** (1) `refc_v3_train.py` is **4,029 lines at HEAD**
and **4,189 in the worktree with uncommitted edits** (blob comparison, both operands 40
chars, MISMATCH) — the tree grew ~160 lines **during** the audit; every finding above was
verified against **both** HEAD and worktree. (2) The brief's *"~3,634 lines"* is refcv5's
launch-time snapshot and is stale. (3) ⛔ **No claim is made about which sibling is doing
what**: `git log` / `git status` pathspec-scoped queries returned empty, which on this mount
is **indistinguishable from a failed query** (`D-GMOUNT-TAR-SILENT-1` family) ⇒
**INCONCLUSIVE**, and every finding above rests instead on a **positive content assertion**
against the file or the HEAD blob.

| **D-CONSTRAINT-GATE-FIRES-1** | ⭐ **THE GATE FIRES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND A ONE-SIDED METRIC WOULD HAVE MISSED THE CREEPING ARM.** B1 EVAL, 139/141 clips, **1,951 windows**, tactical band 2.0–6.0 s. `gt_x2speed` and `gt_creep` hold `gt`'s **PATH fixed**, so the ceilings are bit-identical and only the speed channel moves (one variable). `frac_over_ceiling`: `gt` **0.1229** · ⛔ `gt_x2speed` **0.4755** (3.9× — the OVER-side regression fires) · ⛔ `gt_creep` **0.0041**. `frac_under_when_allowed`: `gt_creep` **1.0000** — **caught by the UNDER side while reading ~0 on the OVER side, i.e. a one-sided criterion would have scored it near-perfect.** ⛔ **Vacuity gate reported beside every number: manoeuvre_rate 0.2019 (394/1,951)** | ⭐ **MEASURED (instrument, 0 GPU)** | `raw/constraint_panel_b1eval.json` |

Cause: an adjacent-lane or parked car 2 m aside is not a longitudinal constraint. ⇒ **TWO DIFFERENT QUANTITIES**: `trajectory_clearance` (min distance to ANY agent) is a PROXIMITY statistic and must never become a speed ceiling; `lead_gap` (in-corridor, ahead, `gap = cx − l/2`) is what bounds speed. Both pinned by mutation tests | ⭐ **MEASURED + fixed + pinned** | `RESULT.md` §3.2 · `stack/tests/test_constraints.py` |
| **D-CLEARANCE-IS-AGENT-NOT-INFRA-1** | ⛔ **THERE IS NO INFRASTRUCTURE-CLEARANCE SIGNAL, AND TWO WIDELY-QUOTED PREMISES ARE WRONG.** (i) The 11th `obstacle.offline` label is **`train_or_tram_car`** (69 boxes / 3 clips on B1 eval; **2,419 measured 2026-07-27**; 275 on a disjoint 193-clip train set), **NOT** `protruding_object` — which was always inside the canonical 10-class `ALL_CLASSES`. `refc_agents.py` asserts `train_or_tram_car` does not exist and **two guards would now FAIL if the enum were corrected** (`refcv5_preflight.py`, `test_refc_agents.py`); the 69 boxes currently train as class-unknown (`-1`), silent not fatal. (ii) **NO CLASS IS STATIC** — the vendor `nurec` config marks all 11 `is_dynamic: true`, and three programme statements agree the feature holds no infrastructure. "World-static" is a per-**TRACK** measured property (**1,756/2,778 = 63.2 %**, parked cars), never a class property ⇒ parked cars are a **PROXY** for the roadside edge and must be named as one. Geometry is a **2D oriented BEV rect** (`cx, cy, yaw, l, w`); `center_z`/`size_z` are dropped by the join, so **height clearance is not computable**. MEASURED clearance on B1 eval: **n = 68,977** steps, p05 **1.99 m**, p50 **8.06 m**, p95 **37.26 m**; censoring stated per family — **49.67 %** no kinematic ceiling, **65.09 %** no clearance ceiling, **33.20 %** neither. ⛔ **DATUM: rig-origin to box EDGE, ego footprint NOT subtracted** — `lead_source`'s convention, **NOT** `alpasim-gsplat/cl_metrics.py`'s bumper-to-bumper `EGO_LEN = 4.7 m`; **the two differ by 4.7 m and must never be mixed** | ⭐ **MEASURED** | `RESULT.md` §3.3 |
| **D-UNDERDRIVE-UNSCOREABLE-1** | ⛔⛔ **THE PI'S "REACH MAX SPEED WHEN THE SITUATION ALLOWS" HALF CANNOT BE SCORED TODAY, AND THAT IS A DATASET DECISION, NOT A MODELLING CHOICE.** GT is competent human driving, so a criterion flagging it as under-driving on most windows is measuring the CEILING's uninformativeness. Sweeping BOTH thresholds (allows ∈ {8,12,16,20} m/s × margin ∈ {3,5,10} m/s), **the GT under-rate never falls below 0.51 anywhere on the grid and RISES with the threshold** — the signature of a degenerate criterion (0.7960 at allows 8 → **0.9276** at allows 20, margin 3). The LEAD/NO_LEAD split localises it exactly: where a real lead gap binds it is **0.29–0.77**; where none does (**23,534 / 43,298 = 54.4 %** of scored steps) the only ceiling is kinematic, ~50 m/s on a straight road, and the criterion collapses to *"GT is not driving at 50 m/s"* — true on **99.87 %** of no-lead steps. ⇒ **the OVER side is scoreable today; the UNDER side REQUIRES a road-speed ceiling that exists in no layer.** ⛔ Routes costed with their honest errors in `SPEC.md` §6; **OSM map-matching is IMPOSSIBLE** on PhysicalAI (`egomotion` carries no lat/lon — clip-local metres). ⛔ **No proxy was invented and nothing was scored against one** | ⭐ **MEASURED** · 🔴 **PI DECISION REQUIRED** | `RESULT.md` §4 · `raw/constraint_panel_b1eval.json::under_side_sensitivity` |
| **H-CONSTRAINT-2SIDED-1** | ⭐ **PRE-REGISTERED, UNRUN.** A constraint loss on the two-sided envelope reduces `frac_over_ceiling` without trading away `ade_m`. **PASS** = paired episode-cluster bootstrap CI excludes zero **and** \|delta\| exceeds the arm's own **INFERENCE-seed** replicate floor, with `ade_m` not degraded beyond its own replicate floor. **FAIL** = NULL, REGRESSION, or TRADED. ⛔ Includes a **deliberate-regression arm** (`cons_regress`, constraint loss sign flipped) that **MUST FAIL** — if the gate cannot fail an arm trained to violate, a PASS means nothing. ⛔ The UNDER side is **deliberately excluded from the success criterion** (`D-UNDERDRIVE-UNSCOREABLE-1`): committing a criterion to a degenerate statistic is how a gate gets passed by an artifact. Controls: `constant_only` (exactly 0.0), `raw_input_floor` (GT's own rate), `paired(a,a)` (exactly 0.0000), `manoeuvre_rate` beside every number. ⛔ `oracle_sel`/`anchor_acc`/`sel_agrees_oracle` INVALID on refcv4b-family arms; the `\|dyaw\| > 0.15` gate is never used | ⭐ **PRE-REGISTERED — both outcomes committed before the arm exists** | `…/2026-09-06-constraints/SPEC.md` §0, §2, §3 |

⭐ **What this stream does NOT establish.** (1) **No driving claim of any kind — nothing was
trained and no model was scored.** The `gt`/`gt_x2speed`/`gt_creep` arms are trajectory arms over
banked GT and characterise the INSTRUMENT. (2) `D-VT-VISION-NULL-1` is a **linear** readout on a
**frozen** trunk without `ego_dropout` — it does not show the target speed is unlearnable, only
that it is not linearly decodable from that representation. (3) The 6–10 m/s stratification in
§2 is **POST-HOC** and needs its own pre-registration before it is quoted. (4) The B1 corpus is
**not parity** ⇒ inadmissible for any parity claim or comparison with the parity arms. (5) The
`vtarget_guarded` ΔR² figures are **INHERITED** from the 2026-08-04 package, cited with paths and
not re-derived here.
